verdicts.reason: A: the text panel runs off the top, right and bottom edges, so it reads as a cropped slab instead of the original floating card. The logo is indented and doesn't line up with the headline's left edge, the 'OBSIDIAN ONE' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, the right earcup touches the panel edge, and the centred CTA clashes with the left-aligned text. B: it keeps the floating card with a clean top margin and the logo aligns with the text, but the card still bleeds off the right edge. B also moves the eyebrow below the body copy, the earcup butts against the card, the logo is tiny, and the CTA is centred under left-aligned copy. B is the tidier of the two and closer to the original.
